verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Insomnia acts as an MCP client (discovering and invoking external MCP servers, e.g. docs-30, docs-14), but there is no evidence Insomnia itself exposes an official MCP server that other agents could connect to. Since Insomnia is a tool/platform (not itself an agent), this axis applies, and the absence of a documented official MCP server endpoint means it is not delivered.
